remarks: Spacious 1 bedroom/1 bathroom apartment in East Norwalk, offering approximately 750 sq. ft. of comfortable living space. The unit features brand-new vinyl flooring. The kitchen comes fully equipped with a stainless steel gas range and refrigerator. There is a common laundry area in the basement for added convenience. Parking includes 1 off-street parking space. Utilities & Responsibilities: Tenant is responsible for all utilities including heat/hot water, electricity, cooking gas, internet, etc. Great location close to SoNo, beaches, parks, dining, and shopping. Perfect for commuters: 5 minute drive to I-95 and 3 minute drive/13 minute walk to East Norwalk Train Station (Metro-North Railroad New Haven line).
